questions.question_text: Write the number 13205.17268 correct to 1 decimal place,
Write the number 13205.17268 correct to 3 significant figures,
Write the number 13205.17268 correct to the nearest 10,
Write the number 13205.17268 correct to the nearest 0.001.
Write the number 120 correct to the nearest 10.
Factorise 3x^2 - 10x - 8
Solve the inequality 3x^2 - 10x - 8 < 0
Solve the equation 3 sin^2 x - 10 sin x - 8 = 0 for 0° < x < 360°
y is directly proportional to (x + 1)^3. y = 32 when x = 3. Find the value of y when x = 4.
y is directly proportional to (x + 1)^3. y = 32 when x = 3. Find the value of x when y = 13.5.
y is directly proportional to (x + 1)^3. y = 32 when x = 3. Find x in terms of y.
A circle of radius r cm is inside a square, so that the circle touches the sides of the square. Find an expression for the area of the shaded region in terms of pi and r.
Calculate the area of the shaded region when r = 6.
Find an expression for the perimeter of the shaded region in terms of pi and r.
The area of triangle ABC is 34.1 cm^2. AB = 12.4 cm and angle ABC = 30°. Show that BC = 11 cm.
Find AC.
Find angle CAB.
Find the length of the perpendicular line from A to the line BC.
The heights of 400 students are given in the table. Calculate an estimate of the mean height of a student.
Complete the frequency density column in this table.
On the grid below, draw an accurate histogram to show this information. Complete the scale on the frequency density axis.

Sasha bought a house on 1st January 2013. By 1st January 2014 the value of the house had increased by 10%. By 1st January 2015 the value of the house had increased by a further 5% of its value on 1st January 2014. The value of the house on 1st January 2015 was $103 950. Find how much Sasha paid for the house in 2013.

By 1st January each year, from 2015, the value of the house increases by 5% of its value on 1st January the previous year. The value of the house on 1st January 2015 was $103 950. Find the year in which the value of the house will first be greater than $200 000.
ABC is a triangle. AX = 2/3 AC and AD = 1/2 AB. AX = 6p and DX = q. Find an expression, in terms of p and q, for AD.
Find an expression, in terms of p and q, for DC.
Find an expression, in terms of p and q, for CB.

The transformation AB means transformation B followed by transformation A. P is rotation 90° clockwise about origin, Q is rotation 180° about origin, R is rotation 270° clockwise about origin, S is reflection in y-axis, T is reflection in x-axis. Write down the letter of the single transformation, P, Q, R, S or T, that is equivalent to each of the transformations QR, PQR, ST, SQ, PTP and TPP.
Draw the image of triangle A after a reflection in the line y = x. Label this image B.
Draw the image of triangle B after a reflection in the x-axis. Label this image C.
Describe fully the single transformation that maps triangle C onto triangle A.
Complete the scatter diagram. The first four points have been plotted for you.
What type of correlation is shown by the scatter diagram?
Find the mean score before taking the drug.
Find the mean score after taking the drug.
Find the equation of the regression line for y in terms of x.
Estimate the score after taking the drug when the score before taking the drug was 30.
A patient has a score before taking the drug of 80. Explain why using the line of regression is unlikely to be reliable in predicting the score of the patient after taking the drug.
On the diagram, sketch the graph of y = f(x) between x = -1 and x = 5 for f(x) = 3 + 1 / (x^2 - 4x + 3).
Write down the equations of the three asymptotes.
Write down the co-ordinates of the local maximum point.
The line y = x intersects the curve y = 3 + 1 / (x^2 - 4x + 3) three times. Find the values of the x co-ordinates of these three points of intersection.
A, B, C and D lie on a circle. ADE and BCE are straight lines that intersect at E. BD = DE, angle BAD = 4x, angle BCD = 6x and angle BDC = 3x. Find x.
Find angle CBD.
Find angle CDE.
Diagram 1 is a sector of a circle, radius 3 cm and sector angle 60°. Calculate the area of Diagram 1.
Diagram 2 has a right-angled triangle, with an angle of 60°, drawn on a radius of this sector. Calculate the area of Diagram 2.
Diagram 3 has a sector of a circle, with a sector angle 60°, drawn on the hypotenuse of the right-angled triangle. Calculate the area of Diagram 3.

Diagram 1, Diagram 2 and Diagram 3 are the first three diagrams in a pattern. There are 6 diagrams in the pattern. Diagram 4 has a right-angled triangle added to Diagram 3 in the same way as Diagram 2. Diagram 5 has a sector added to Diagram 4 in the same way as Diagram 3. Diagram 6 has a right-angled triangle added to Diagram 5 in the same way as Diagram 2. Find the area of Diagram 6.

A bag contains x red balls and y blue balls. Rosario chooses a ball at random from the bag, replaces it, and chooses a second time. Find the probability, in terms of x and y, that the two balls chosen are both red.
Find the probability, in terms of x and y, that the two balls chosen are one red and one blue.
Magda chooses a ball at random from the bag and does not replace it. She then chooses a second ball. Find the probability, in terms of x and y, that the two balls chosen are both red.
Find the probability, in terms of x and y, that the two balls chosen are one red and one blue.
